insights.concise_text: NeuronBlocks addresses engineers' productivity and less optimal solution challenges with a two-layer design that balances generality and flexibility.

triple.subject: NeuronBlocks two-layer design
triple.object: engineers' productivity and less optimal solution challenges

insights.concise_text: The upper layer and bottom layer in the Introduction correspond to the Model Zoo and Block Zoo in the Design section.

triple.subject: upper layer and bottom layer
triple.object: Model Zoo and Block Zoo

insights.concise_text: Because NeuronBlocks is built on PyTorch, its JSON configuration workflow provides higher level abstraction that hides PyTorch framework details.

triple.subject: NeuronBlocks JSON configuration workflow
triple.object: higher level abstraction that hides PyTorch framework details

insights.concise_text: NeuronBlocks' two-layer design responds to prior toolkits being limited to certain tasks and not flexible enough for new architectures or components.

triple.subject: NeuronBlocks two-layer design
triple.object: limited task coverage and inflexibility of prior toolkits

insights.concise_text: The Model Architecture interface implements the workflow's Block Zoo construction path by defining a list of layers/blocks from the Block Zoo gallery.

triple.subject: Model Architecture interface
triple.object: Block Zoo construction path

insights.concise_text: The knowledge distillation template's goal of improving inference speed is supported by the student model's 23-27 times inference speedup on Domain Classification Dataset.

triple.subject: knowledge distillation template
triple.object: 23-27 times inference speedup on Domain Classification Dataset

insights.concise_text: NeuronBlocks' claim of reliable and competitive results on various tasks is evidenced by competitive or even better results on GLUE tasks and WikiQA dataset.

triple.subject: GLUE tasks and WikiQA dataset results
triple.object: reliable and competitive results on various tasks

insights.concise_text: Using BiLSTM and Attention based models on GLUE benchmark tasks yielded competitive or even better results with minimal coding efforts.

triple.subject: BiLSTM and Attention based models on GLUE benchmark tasks
triple.object: competitive or even better results with minimal coding efforts

insights.concise_text: Using CNN, BiLSTM, and Attention based models on WikiQA dataset yielded competitive or even better results with simple model configurations.

triple.subject: CNN, BiLSTM, and Attention based models on WikiQA dataset
triple.object: competitive or even better results with simple model configurations
